description:
Perform a safety audit for 8 chemicals to identify peroxide formation hazards. 

Goal: Look up each chemical on CAMEO Chemicals (https://cameochemicals.noaa.gov/), check its 'Reactivity Profile' and 'Air & Water Reactions' for peroxide warnings, and classify it.

Chemicals to audit:
1. Diethyl ether
2. Tetrahydrofuran
3. Acetone
4. Diisopropyl ether
5. Methanol
6. Isopropylbenzene
7. Toluene
8. Acetic acid

Create a report file at '~/Desktop/peroxide_audit_report.txt' with the exact format below:

PEROXIDE AUDIT REPORT
=====================
1. Diethyl ether: [PEROXIDE FORMER or NOT A PEROXIDE FORMER]
2. Tetrahydrofuran: [PEROXIDE FORMER or NOT A PEROXIDE FORMER]
...
(continue for all 8 chemicals)

For peroxide formers, include a brief note on the next line citing the warning found.
